title: Halloween Countdown
description: Animated trick-or-treat street with a countdown to Halloween.

enabled.description: Show the Halloween Countdown in the rotation

display_duration.description: How long the scene stays on screen each time (seconds)

show_countdown.description: Show "X DAYS TO HALLOWEEN" in the top-left corner (HAPPY HALLOWEEN on the day)

animation_speed.description: How fast everything moves: 1 is normal, 0.5 is half speed, 2 is double

surprise_every_seconds.description: Roughly how often a surprise happens (bats, a witch, trick-or-treating...), in seconds

animation_fps.description: Animation frames per second. Lower it if the Pi struggles.
